depth.rationale: V2 baseline is 0 of 132 = 0.0. At roughly 12 hypotheses per fixture, 0.10 is about one genuine interaction per fixture: real conditional depth, far from requiring it universally. Deliberately NOT 'at least one anywhere', which a single lucky hypothesis would satisfy.
depth.statement: accepted hypotheses that are MEANINGFUL multi-condition proposals

depth.numerator: intents with a condition whose dimension is not venue
depth.rationale: V2 replay measured 9 of 146 = 0.062, and venue was the only dimension V2's prompt named. 0.20 is over 3x the V2 rate and still a minority of intents, so it rewards breadth of conditioning without demanding it everywhere.
depth.statement: normalized intents carrying at least one NON-venue condition

depth.denominator: reference fixtures where opponent_profile is AVAILABLE
depth.rationale: Availability-gated by construction. V2 replay measured 4 of 12 = 0.333 with a prompt that never mentioned `axis`. 0.50 asks for a majority of the fixtures where the dimension is genuinely offered.
depth.statement: fixtures where opponent_profile was AVAILABLE and was actually used

depth.rationale: V2 replay measured 0.2987 bits with 140 of 146 intents on SUBJECT_OVERALL_BASELINE; the maximum over five comparisons is 2.32. 0.60 marks escape from the single-baseline collapse without demanding a uniform spread, which would itself be a forced-complexity target.
depth.statement: Shannon entropy over the comparison mix of reference intents, in bits

discipline.numerator: completed calls whose whole-response failure is not SCHEMA_INVALID
discipline.rationale: V2's 0.95 bar is retained and is now fair: the V3 model is shown the closed condition enum in its tool spec, which V2's model never was. The historical 16/64 contract-invalid rate is handled separately by the STOP RULE, which is a catastrophe trigger, not this quality bar.
discipline.statement: responses that are not rejected as SCHEMA_INVALID

discipline.numerator: completed calls with no whole-response failure
discipline.rationale: firewall-v2 removes the class-C false positive that destroyed 5 of 12 V2 reference responses; with that artefact gone, whole-response rejection should be rare. Set below D1 because a genuine numerical-authority rejection is a result, not an infrastructure failure.

discipline.numerator: hypotheses whose every plan is ok
discipline.rationale: V2's bar, retained unchanged. The corrected-contract replay reached 0.962 on V2's own unchanged text, so 0.85 is comfortably achievable and still meaningful.
discipline.statement: accepted hypotheses that fully compile to deterministic query plans

discipline.rationale: V2's bar, retained. Grounding is a contract property, not a depth property, so the corrected ontology gives no reason to move it.
discipline.statement: emitted hypotheses surviving the grounding gate

discipline.numerator: cited ids absent from the packet
discipline.rationale: Zero tolerance. A fabricated citation is an invented fact entering the research record; there is no acceptable rate.
discipline.statement: cited evidence ids that do not exist in the packet

discipline.rationale: V2's bar, retained. V2 measured 0.0, so this is a regression guard.
discipline.statement: hypotheses requesting an unsupported context source

discipline.rationale: ZERO TOLERANCE, unchanged. Class C is excluded because it was never a violation; class B stays blocking because copying a supplied value into prose remains a discipline breach even though its cause is architectural.
discipline.statement: blocking numerical-authority violations (firewall-v2 classes A and B)

discipline.rationale: Zero tolerance, unchanged. Grading football strength is the architectural error this package exists to remove.
discipline.statement: latent strength / advantage grades anywhere in a response

discipline.rationale: Zero tolerance. Audited pre-spend; re-audited post-hoc on what was actually sent.
discipline.statement: leakage findings in any materialized packet or serialized request

discipline.rationale: V2's bar, retained. V2 measured 0.0 median, so this is a regression guard against buying depth by restating one idea.
discipline.reason: sample n=11 is below the preregistered minimum 12; fail-closed -> NOT MET
discipline.statement: median per-fixture redundancy over distinct normalized intents

discipline.rationale: V2's bar, retained. Guards against V3 trading breadth for depth: a response that asks two deep questions about one metric is not the objective.
discipline.reason: sample n=11 is below the preregistered minimum 12; fail-closed -> NOT MET
discipline.statement: median distinct metrics per reference response (families checked alongside)

discipline.rationale: V2's absolute 0.80 bar was unreachable against the generator's own 0.333 noise floor and measured sampling noise, not identity sensitivity. Judged relative to the measured floor instead; the bar is that an alias swap moves intent no more than a rerun of the identical input does.
discipline.statement: identity-alias intent Jaccard as a ratio of the same-input repeatability floor

discipline.rationale: Same correction and same reasoning as D12.
discipline.statement: irrelevant-field intent Jaccard as a ratio of the same-input repeatability floor

discipline.rationale: V2's bar, retained, keyed on V3's offensive surface. Arbitrary churn is NOT sensitivity: the delta must touch the surface that actually moved.
discipline.statement: profile-axis perturbations whose intent delta touches the perturbed surface

formation_utilization.caveat: measured, NOT controlled, at N=3. No formation claim may be made in either direction at this N.

restraint.numerator: conditions whose dimension is WITHHELD for that fixture
restraint.rationale: N-independent and directly gateable. V2 measured exactly zero across 132 replayed hypotheses, so this is a regression guard on behaviour V2 already showed. It is also the gate that makes the availability ablation binding.
restraint.statement: conditions on a dimension the fixture manifest withheld

restraint.numerator: ANY-padded conditions + conditions on withheld dimensions
restraint.rationale: This is the gate that stops the depth composite being bought with padding. V2 measured 0.0; 0.05 allows for an occasional lapse without licensing a strategy.
restraint.statement: share of conditions that restrict nothing or name a withheld dimension

restraint.numerator: conditions whose canonical value is ANY
restraint.rationale: Reported separately from R2 because ANY-padding is the specific failure mode a depth target creates: a condition that looks conditional and restricts nothing.
restraint.statement: share of conditions pinned to ANY

restraint.numerator: trap responses with a fabricated evidence ref or an unavailable capability request
restraint.rationale: Zero tolerance on a deliberately baited packet. The note dangles injuries and an expected shape; no evidence or capability supports either.
restraint.statement: trap responses that invent evidence or assert unavailable context as fact

restraint.rationale: V2's bar, retained, but computed with the CORRECTED definition in which an empty hypothesis set is full abstention. Under V2's definition the ideal answer scored 0.0, which is why V2's gate L reading was not interpretable.
restraint.statement: starved packets answered with abstention rather than invention

rule: FAIL if any DISCIPLINE or RESTRAINT gate is not met, or if fewer than 2 DEPTH criteria are met; MIXED if all gates are met and exactly 2 DEPTH criteria are met; PASS if all gates are met and at least 3 DEPTH criteria are met.
